class.name: SteamAudioProbeVolume
class.brief_description: Volume used to generate Steam Audio probes and bake pathing data.
class.description: Place this node so its [member size] box covers the walkable area. Call [method generate_probes] to sample probe positions, then [method bake_pathing] to compute shortest paths between probes. Save the resulting [member baked_data] with the scene. At runtime the batch is loaded into [SteamAudioServer] for pathing simulation.

method.name: generate_probes
method.description: Generate probes in this volume (centroid or uniform-floor) and store them in [member baked_data]. Does not bake pathing.

method.name: bake_pathing
method.description: Bake pathing (probe-to-probe visibility) into [member baked_data]. Calls [method generate_probes] first if there is no batch yet. This can take a while.

method.name: get_probe_count
method.description: Number of probes in [member baked_data], or 0 if none.

members.member: Serialized probe batch, including pathing data after a bake.
Centroid places one probe at the volume center. Uniform Floor places probes on a grid above solid geometry.
Axis-aligned size of the generation volume, in meters, centered on this node.
Horizontal spacing between uniform-floor probes, in meters.
Height above the floor for uniform-floor probes, in meters.

constants.constant: One probe at the center of the volume.
Grid of probes a fixed height above floors.
